notes: Input provided no study/outcome locators or neutral description. The primary replication report explicitly selects Table 3 panel d, female sample, in the original; this identifies the target without outside dataset information. Original title and DOI verified in the publisher-version repository PDF. Original paper prints the two regression coefficients and their equality-test p value, but no effect size or test statistic for the contrast itself; no subtraction or conversion performed. Replication requested Cohen's f^2 is not printed in the final report; extracted the printed F statistic for the same equality test as the p value, without converting it. Input OSF URL 8rwkn identifies the final-report file rather than a project node; project j8en2 from the supplied citation lists that exact file. Replication report dated November 22nd, 2020; supplied project citation dated November 18, 2025. No paid or signed-in acquisition.
